title: System architecture for the 5G System (5GS)
tagline: 5G architecture — where PCF, SMF, UPF, and NRF fit
summary: TS 23.501 defines the overall 5G System architecture including network functions, service-based interfaces, and reference points. For the 29.512 story, it establishes the roles of PCF (policy), SMF (session management), UPF (user plane), and NRF (discovery) that the PDU session policy journey depends on.
defines: 5G Core network function roles and responsibilities
Reference points between SMF, PCF, AMF, and UPF
PDU session architecture and user-plane path
whyItMatters: Before diving into individual API specs, 23.501 answers which NF owns which concern. The SM policy call in 29.512 only makes sense once you know SMF manages sessions and PCF owns policy decisions.
